scope: Chip-level pad ring around the ADC core of floorplan.json: pad order, ADC placement, pad-to-core routes, pad decoupling and the reserved regions in the ring opening. Die coordinates; floorplan.json io_ring links here.
die_note: Pad-ring outline from the generator (7 x 60 um + 2 x 110 um corners). The seal ring and scribe lane add to it per the shuttle rules.

domains.ana: Ring supply AVDDR/AVSSR on PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC (domain providers: the TACVDD/TACVSS bus of every analog pad). ADC supply AVDD/AVSS on PVDD1AC/PVSS1AC: one pair per branch (analog trunk, XREF/CDAC pair, SAR) and one AVSS for the guard ring. VINP, VINN and two VREFP and two VREFN pads on PDB3AC. Top, left and right_6.
domains.dig: DVDD/DVSS core-side supply (PVDD1DGZ/PVSS1DGZ), VDDIO/VSSIO output-driver supply (PVDD2POC/PVSS2DGZ); D0-D7 out and SAMPLE in on PDDW16SDGZ. Bottom and right_0..5.

chip_netlist.XRING (generated IO ring): Core side: AVDD, AVSS, VINP, VINN, VREFP, VREFN, SAMPLE_CORE, D0_CORE-D7_CORE, DVDD, DVSS. Ring buses only: AVDDR/AVSSR (analog TACVDD/TACVSS), VDDIO/VSSIO (VDDPST/VSSPST). AVDDR_CORE/AVSSR_CORE (the 3AC pads' AVDD/AVSS pins) stay unconnected.
chip_netlist.note: The three AVDD and four AVSS pads are one net each; their branches join only inside the ADC at VDD!/0, and the guard ring joins AVSS through the substrate ties.

route_check.rules: Distinct routes never touch, whatever their net; each starts on its pad (or ADC pin) and lands on its ADC pin, the register or the guard ring; every ADC pin and every non-ring pad has exactly one route; all stay in the ring opening and off the ADC core; no digital route enters an analog region and no analog route a digital one; a route enters only its own branch's decoupling; VINN/VINP and the analog trunk pair are mirror images about the ADC axis.

reserved_regions.use: ADC core from floorplan.json (122 x 111 um), R0, its mirror axis on die x 290 midway between VINN and VINP.
2 um P+ AVSS ring 2 um outside the ADC outline, fed from the left_0 AVSS pad on its west side. Routes cross it on M7 and above.
VINN/VINP on the low track, the analog trunk pair between them on the high track, analog_pad_decap above. No digital net enters.
Analog-branch AVDD-AVSS bulk between the VIN routes, on the trunk next to its pads; about 2 ohm ESR to the trunk.
The four reference bonds as one interleaved bundle onto the ADC west edge, and the guard feed. No decoupling, no digital net.
XREF/CDAC-branch AVDD-AVSS bulk just below the ADC, on the pair routes; about 2 ohm ESR.
SAR-branch AVDD-AVSS bulk in the NE corner between its two pads; about 2 ohm ESR. 12 um clear of the VINP route.
SAR AVDD/AVSS from sar_pad_decap to the ADC east edge above SAMPLE. No digital net enters.
Eight flip-flops on DVDD/DVSS clocked by SAMPLE rising, with buffers for the pad I pins. D inputs 6 um from the ADC east edge.
DVDD-DVSS decoupling for the register and the pad core-side logic.
Q0-Q7 from the register to the east and south pads; DVSS. No analog net enters.
D3-D7 along the bottom pads. No analog net enters.

analog.serves: Comparator and Bootstrap cells through analog_decap_slot (9.3 pF in core)

pair.serves: XREF gate drivers and CDAC through xref_decap (10.1 pF in core)

sar.serves: SAR macro through sar_decap_north and sar_supply_and_decap (8.25 pF in core)

supply_plan.pad_decoupling: About 100 pF AVDD-AVSS bulk per branch at 10 fF/um2 with about 2 ohm ESR, as the Stage 1 budget recommends (power_plan.io_ring): branch droop 40 -> 25 mV (pair, analog) and 28 -> 13 mV (SAR), pin peaks halved. The budget's feed limit is 6 ohm between the bulk and the core.
supply_plan.reference: VREFP/VREFN: two bonds each on interleaved pads (left_1..4), four separate tracks onto four boundary pins on the ADC west edge in the same order. No decoupling at the pads or under the routes: the 8 pF between the rails and the two 15 ohm resistors are in the core.
supply_plan.analog_ring: AVDDR/AVSSR (top_1/top_6, PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC) power the analog pads' TACVDD/TACVSS ESD bus only. Bond them to the same 0.9 V source as AVDD/AVSS on the board (TACVDD must cover the 0.9 V VIN/VREF swing).
supply_plan.digital_core: DVDD/DVSS (right_4/right_3) feed the output register and the core side of the digital pads only.
supply_plan.io: VDDIO/VSSIO (bottom_5/bottom_0) feed the output drivers; no core connection.

die_frame.decision: 7 x 7 ring, 28 pads, 640 x 640 um outline.
die_frame.basis: 23 pads are required (two VIN, four reference bonds, the analog ring pair, the analog trunk pair, four digital supplies, nine digital signals). The other five give the XREF/CDAC and SAR branches their own AVDD/AVSS pairs, as the Stage 6 model assumes (one VDD/VSS pair per branch), and the guard ring its own AVSS bond. Supersedes the 6 x 6 draft, which had no room for the double reference bonds.

reference_bonds.decision: VREFP and VREFN on two pads each in the order VREFP, VREFN, VREFP, VREFN (left_1..4), each pad on its own track to its own ADC boundary pin; the two pins of a rail join inside the core ahead of its 15 ohm resistor.
reference_bonds.basis: Stage 1 budget (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#15): double bonds bring the worst decision error over the tolerance box from 0.105 to 0.040 LSB. Separate tracks keep the interleave on chip and need no crossing in the ring opening; reference bulk at the pads raises the error, so the reference channel holds none.

adc_supply.decision: The ADC keeps its single VDD!/0 supply. The analog trunk, the XREF/CDAC pair and the SAR each get their own AVDD/AVSS pad pair, route and pad decoupling, and join only inside the ADC at VDD!/0. The SAR pair enters the east edge above SAMPLE, into sar_decap_north.
adc_supply.basis: No netlist change and no extra supply-domain crossings; SAR switching current has its own bond wires and never shares metal with the comparator/Bootstrap or XREF feeds.

analog_pad_roles.decision: PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC (AVDDR/AVSSR) supply only the analog ring bus; PVDD1AC/PVSS1AC (AVDD/AVSS) supply the ADC core, as PVDD2POC/PVSS2DGZ and PVDD1DGZ/PVSS1DGZ do on the digital side.
analog_pad_roles.basis: In the LVS-clean IO_RING_T28_12x12_01 extraction, PVDD1AC's pad is its AVDD pin with a clamp to TACVSS, while the PVDD3AC pad is the TACVDD bus and its AVDD pin extracts as a separate net (VDDIB_CORE).

data_outputs.decision: D0-D7 reach the pads through an output register on DVDD clocked by SAMPLE rising.
data_outputs.basis: D0-D7 are AN2D1 outputs inside the SAR next-word loop, qualified at 5 fF, and change bit by bit during conversion. Registered, the pads switch once per frame, 45 ns before the sampling edge, with one frame of latency.

open_items: Stage 6 reference model: add the on-chip reference routes (VREFP_a 177.885 um, VREFN_a 143.885 um, VREFP_b 197.885 um, VREFN_b 251.885 um) and the PDB3AC pad capacitance (ESD clamps on AIO; the budget assumed 0.5 pF per pad). The extracted IO_RING_T28_12x12_01 shows PDB3AC's AIO as one node from the bond pad to the core, with no series resistor.
Feed widths: size each branch route for the budget's 6 ohm feed (with its in-core strap) and for EM at the pin peaks (reference 5.1 mA per rail over both bonds, VDD 5.5 mA summed over the pins).
Pad decoupling: implement the 2 ohm ESR (series strip or gate resistance) and use the PDK decap density and leakage, as for the in-core regions.

In-core feeds from the new boundary pins (floorplan.json open_items): the two pins of each reference rail join inside vref_decap_west with one VREFP/VREFN crossing on the pad side of the resistors; the pair feed from xref_decap's south-west corner reaches the rail west ends past the reference network; the SAR feed runs from sar_decap_north to sar_supply_and_decap.
D0-D7 load: the in-core M7 route over the SAR (29.6 um) plus the register input is about 8-10 fF per bit against the 5 fF in the specification. Stage 2 should use 10 fF.
Register hold: at SAMPLE rising the register captures D while the ADC starts resetting it. Check the hold margin at FF -40/125 C; add delay on D if needed.
Output switching: one VDDIO/VSSIO pair serves eight outputs that can all toggle at once (0x7F to 0x80). Check the ground bounce at the chosen PDDW16SDGZ drive strength.
Cross-domain interfaces: SAMPLE (pad, DVDD, into the ADC, VDD!) and D0-D7 (ADC, VDD!, into the register, DVDD) cross between the two 0.9 V supplies; review them with the ESD rules.

Analog ring pads: confirm in the tphn28hpcpgv18 databook that the PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC AVDD/AVSS pins may stay open, and the allowed AVDDR level against AVDD (the earlier rings left VDDIB_CORE/VSSIB_CORE open and passed LVS).
Bonding and package: PAD60GU single row at 60 um pitch; Stage 6 needs the actual bond geometry, including the interleaved reference wires.
Steps 7-10 (Virtuoso, DRC, LVS) run only after the plan is accepted, into SAR_ADC_T28_LAYOUT.
